posts.title: Grokipedia selectively drawing on more right-leaning news sources, new study
posts.description: A large-scale analysis of Grokipedia, the world’s first AI-written encyclopedia, has found that while many Grokipedia articles closely resemble their Wikipedia counterparts, a substantial subset diverged markedly in style, sourcing, and political leaning.
